query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_revision a JOIN meta_messaging_revision b ON b.connection_id=a.connection_id AND b.provider_message_id=a.provider_message_id WHERE a.connection_id=$1 AND a.customer_id=$2 AND b.customer_id=$3 AND a.direction<>b.direction AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_message m WHERE m.connection_id=a.connection_id AND m.customer_id=$2 AND m.provider_message_id=a.provider_message_id))
